Container.Name: Cerberus-AIO
Container.Overview: Cerberus is a self-hosted website security and quality scanner with local Lighthouse, Nuclei, OWASP ZAP, sqlmap, local users, history, PDF-ready reports, and optional AI analysis. This AIO master launches the isolated child stack. It requires the Docker socket, which grants control of the Docker host; install only the official image and review release notes before updating.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: website scanner lighthouse nuclei zap sqlmap security pentest
Container.Requires: Docker socket access; approximately 8 GB free disk and 8 GB RAM recommended. Active scans are disabled by default.

Config.Name: AIO configuration
Config.Description: Named Docker volume holding generated AIO secrets. Keep this exact named-volume style so child containers can mount it.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required to create and update child containers. This grants Docker-host control.

Config.Name: Config volume name
Config.Description: Must exactly match the named volume mounted at /config.

Config.Name: Enable active scans
Config.Description: Enables owner-confirmed Nuclei, ZAP, and sqlmap scans. Leave false unless needed.
